title: Synthetic Data Generation — NPGC and baselines
summary: A reproducible research pipeline that trains, evaluates, and compares tabular synthetic-data generators, including the authors' novel NPGC copula method, against several baselines on UCI and educational datasets. SDV's CTGAN, CopulaGAN, TVAE, and GaussianCopula synthesizers (via sdv.single_table) are run as the comparison baselines, with sdv.evaluation.single_table's evaluate_quality used for scoring.
